edge.title: Wrap the #30 stack in EMA-Nesterov (β=0.3·lr/lr0, γ=0.99), 2900 steps
edge.summary: Wraps the whole #30 optimizer (AdamW + Muon, all parameters) in EMA-Nesterov: an EMA (γ=0.99) of the realized per-step weight displacement is added to the weights, scaled by β = 0.3·lr/lr0, before every forward pass during steps 300–1949, so gradients are taken at a lookahead point and the shift is kept (an extra Nesterov-style momentum on the whole trajectory that amplifies the persistent part of the update by ≈1/(1−β) ≈ 1.4× while β = 0.3). The run is also shortened: train_steps 3020→2900 and PowerCool end 3050→2980 (Muon LR now decays from ~594, Adam from ~1567), which moves the μ cooldown to 2800–2900 and puts the lookahead cutoff at train_steps − 950 = 1950. Optimizer internals are otherwise unchanged from #30.

changes.label: EMA-Nesterov lookahead wrapper
changes.detail: optimizers = [EMA_Nesterov(model.parameters(), [optimizer1, optimizer2], lookahead_stepsize=0.3, use_scheduled_lookahead_stepsize=True, lookahead_ema=0.99, prefill_steps=300, rest_steps=train_steps−950)]; nesterov_step() runs before the forward pass, step() runs AdamW then Muon and then accum_lookahead().

changes.label: Horizon 3020→2900, PowerCool end 2980
changes.detail: FINAL_TRAIN_STEPS 3020→2900 and FINAL_SCHEDULE_STEPS 3050→2980 shift every LR decay 70 steps earlier and move the μ cooldown to steps 2800–2900; the claim is at 2890.

changes.label: Hparam loops over inner optimizers
changes.detail: initial_lr / set_hparams now iterate optimizers[0].inner_optimizer; blank-line edits.

edge.parent_check: consistent (diff vs #30 is only the wrapper and the horizon change; the EMA_Nesterov class is the same implementation #39 used on the #12 baseline, with β 0.6→0.3 and window 500–2400→300–1950)
edge.noise: Blank lines; extra_val_steps entries above 2900 are never reached.

mechanisms.name: EMA-Nesterov lookahead wrapper
mechanisms.explain: EMA_Nesterov holds, for every model parameter, the previous post-step weights and a buffer m updated after each step as m ← 0.99·m + 0.01·(θ_new − θ_prev), where the displacement includes the wrapper's own shift. For steps 300–1949, nesterov_step adds β·m to the weights before the forward pass, with β = 0.3 × (current/initial LR of the embed AdamW group); the gradient is taken there and AdamW + Muon update from the shifted point, which is never undone. Net effect: θ_{t+1} = θ_t + β·m_t − η·u(θ_t + β·m_t), an outer heavy-ball/Nesterov momentum on the full weight trajectory that fades with the Adam LR (β ≈ 0.3 until ~1567, ≈0.21 at 1949) and then switches off.

caveats: β is scaled by the embed AdamW group's LR ratio (read before set_hparams runs, i.e. one step stale), not Muon's: Muon's LR starts decaying near step 594 but β stays 0.3 until ~1567. The lookahead buffer keeps accumulating after step 1950 but is unused. No README exists in the result folder; settings are hardcoded in code (no env overrides), and table text matches (β=.3·lr/max_lr, γ=.99, steps 300–1950).
